messages:
matt: deploy-bot flagged an autorevert candidate on hosted-text-gen. p95 spike but error signal is noisy. asking ops for triage and decision (auto revert vs human hold).

deploy-bot: AUTO-REVERT ALERT
metric: route=hosted-text-gen p95 +230ms (baseline 120ms), error_rate +0.3%
action_suggested: autorevert -> v1.7.3

lucy: borderline. i'd prefer human-in-the-loop: pin previous model and tilt 20% back for 15m while we validate.

ops_oncall: what criteria to escalate to full revert? who signs suppression?

elaine: propose: if p95 > +200ms AND error_rate > +0.2% for 10 continuous minutes -> full revert. otherwise allow 20% tilt for 15m. ops_oncall can authorize suppression; engineer oncall executes tilt. commands below:
```
# pin previous model
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.dev/v1/releases/pin -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"route":"hosted-text-gen","target_version":"v1.7.3"}'

# partial traffic split
redwood rollout split --route hosted-text-gen --from v1.8.0 --to v1.7.3 --percent 20
```

jordan: drafting a short release-note blurb in case of revert; pinging CS for heads-up.

matt: pinning v1.7.3 and suppressing autorevert for 15m, will run split on ops confirm.

deploy-bot: AutoRevert suppressed by manual_override (actor=matt) until 6024682317.

ops_oncall: suppression authorized. @matt run the 20% tilt; if p95 stays >+200ms for 10m we do full revert. if errors exceed +0.5% notify SRE.

lucy: applying split now... done. monitoring logs and metrics.

matt: split applied, 20% tilt active.

jordan: release-note draft: "We observed a transient latency increase on hosted-text-gen. Temporarily routing 20% to v1.7.3 while we validate. No customer-facing errors observed."

elaine: LGTM. adding to internal incident tracker and notifying CS.

lucy: 3m after tilt: p95 delta down to +110ms, error_rate 0.12%. tilt helped.

ops_oncall: leaving thread open for 15m window. manual override in place. if thresholds cross, proceed to full revert and update notes. otherwise unpin and resume rollout at the end of window.

matt: monitoring and will post updates every 5m.
